images.caption: Figure 4:Seconds per run (left) and F1 of ITPD (right) versus total time-indexed variables, using Fisher-z CI tests atM=2000M=2000andd=2d=2. Left: For each method, numbers in parentheses give the fitted exponent for the power by which wall-clock time scaled with total variables. Open marks are methods timed in separate runs on shared nodes. Each point is a mean over 10 graphs, and the shaded bands are 95% intervals. Asterisks are estimates from the fitted power law at sizes where the method was not run.
